title: You might want to hold off on this one?
text: You might want to hold off on this one?. [[VIDEOID:5b9f5b926cfc0c3858b408e879ecc361]] Nothing to brag about.  Feels very cheap or lightweight, however you want to see it.  It comes with 1 pad then you have to email the company and they will send you 2 extra after you post a review.  I have seen much better quality steamers.  The pad gets dirty very quickly, but it is white.  In my opinion a bad color choice for the pad and it’s not very plush.

product_metadata.title: OApier S5 Steam Mop, Floor Steamer for Hardwood and Tile, Lightweight Steam Mops for Laminate Floor, Wood Floor Cleaning, 450ml Water Tank
features: Super lightweight design (3.5 pounds without water) to ensure an easy and pleasant experience without compromising any cleaning capabilities. manual pump for superior control over the release of steam, protecting delicate floor finishes.
The 212-degree F heat effectively eliminates dirt and sticky messes, only needs tap water, safe for children, pets and yoga lovers.
Large bottom tank (450ml) for better steam penetration and higher steaming temperature, fits for multiple kinds floors surface, including hardwood floor, tiles, laminate, vinyl.

Say goodbye to messy mops and heavy buckets with the cleverly engineered reusable triple layered microfiber pad for exceptional absorption, steam permeation and optimum friction to remove stubborn stains easily. Optional carpet slider to remove odor.
A quick-release cord - easy to store and release with the 20-feet long power cord, 1 year 24 hours service, please contact us if you need.
